name: Area
label: Area
definition: A part of a site organized around one kind of work.
examples: packaging, utilities, warehouse

name: Asset
label: Asset
definition: Anything in the equipment hierarchy that has a stable identity.
examples: a site, a packaging line, a filler, a seal kit

name: Capability
label: Capability
definition: Something an equipment is able to do, stated independently of any product or order. Matching what a product requires with what a line offers answers where the product can run.
examples: fill 500 ml PET bottles, apply 28 mm caps, wrap-around labelling

name: DataPoint
label: Data point
definition: A measured or derived value that belongs to an asset: a PLC tag, a sensor reading, a computed KPI.
examples: the speed of filler-01, the state of capper-01

name: Enterprise
label: Enterprise
definition: The company as a whole, the root of the hierarchy.
examples: ACME Beverages

name: Equipment
label: Equipment
definition: ISA-95 work cell or unit: one machine that runs, stops and produces.
examples: filler-01 of line 1

name: EquipmentClass
label: Equipment class
definition: A catalogue entry for a kind of equipment. It describes the type, while Equipment is one installed machine of that type.
examples: filler, capper, labeler

name: Event
label: Event
definition: Something that happened to an asset over a period of time. Every domain event inherits where and when from here, which is what lets them be crossed.
examples: a production run, a stop, an inspection, a maintenance order

name: Line
label: Production line
definition: A set of equipment arranged to make product in sequence. Orders are scheduled on lines.
examples: Line 1: filler, capper and labeler

name: OperatingState
label: Operating state
definition: One of the harmonized states every equipment reports, whatever its vendor calls them. The label is the exact text published in the UNS.
examples: RUNNING, IDLE, STOPPED, FAULTED

name: Person
label: Person
definition: Someone who performs or is accountable for work in the plant.
examples: a maintenance technician, a quality inspector

name: Role
label: Role
definition: A function a person performs. Kept apart from the person because people change roles and one role is held by many people.
examples: maintenance technician, quality inspector, line operator

name: Site
label: Site
definition: A plant at one geographic location.
examples: São Paulo plant, Curitiba plant

name: StateChange
label: State change
definition: The moment an equipment moved from one operating state to another.
examples: filler-01 went from RUNNING to FAULTED at 09:00

name: Consumption
label: Consumption interval
definition: The energy a meter recorded between two instants.
examples: 612 kWh on line 1 during the morning shift

name: EnergyBaseline
label: Energy baseline
definition: The energy a product is expected to take per thousand good units, with the tolerance before it counts as a deviation.
examples: still water 500 ml: 3.5 kWh per 1,000 bottles, tolerance 15 %

name: EnergyCarrier
label: Energy carrier
definition: The form in which energy reaches the equipment.
examples: electricity, compressed air, steam

name: EnergyMeter
label: Energy meter
definition: A data point that accumulates the energy used by an asset.
examples: the electricity meter of line 1

name: Material
label: Material
definition: A raw or packaging material, as an item in the catalogue.
examples: cap 28 mm, PET preform, label

name: MaterialLot
label: Material lot
definition: One delivery of a material from one supplier, traceable as a unit.
examples: ML-2207: caps 28 mm delivered by Cap Co

name: StockItem
label: Stock item
definition: The quantity of one material lot that sits in one storage location right now.
examples: 12,000 caps of lot ML-2207 in rack A-03

name: StorageLocation
label: Storage location
definition: A place where material is kept, in a warehouse or at the line.
examples: warehouse rack A-03, point of use at line 1

name: Supplier
label: Supplier
definition: A company that delivers material.
examples: Cap Co, Seal Systems

name: Component
label: Component
definition: A replaceable part of an equipment that maintenance tracks on its own.
examples: seal kit, main motor, valve block

name: CorrectiveOrder
label: Corrective order
definition: Maintenance done because something failed.
examples: MO-0077: replace the seal kit after repeated stops

name: Downtime
label: Downtime
definition: An interval in which equipment did not run when it was scheduled to.
examples: filler-01 stopped 15 minutes for seal wear

name: FailureMode
label: Failure mode
definition: The way something fails. A shared vocabulary instead of free text, so stops can be counted and compared.
examples: seal wear, bottle jam, motor overload

name: MaintenanceOrder
label: Maintenance order
definition: A piece of maintenance work carried out on an asset.
examples: a repair after a failure, a scheduled seal replacement

name: MaintenancePlan
label: Maintenance plan
definition: A recurring preventive task for a component, with its interval and next due date.
examples: replace the filler seal kit every 30 days

name: PreventiveOrder
label: Preventive order
definition: Maintenance done on schedule, before a failure.
examples: MO-0061: scheduled inspection of the main motor

name: SparePart
label: Spare part
definition: A stocked replacement for a component. It is held and fitted, not operated.
examples: seal kit SK-28 for the line 1 filler

name: Changeover
label: Changeover
definition: The planned time spent switching a line from one product or format to another.
examples: line 3 switching from 500 ml to 1 l bottles

name: Lot
label: Lot
definition: The traceable quantity of product made in one run. Quality decisions and recalls are taken per lot.

name: Product
label: Product
definition: A sellable item, identified by its SKU.
examples: still water 500 ml, orange juice 1 l

name: ProductionRun
label: Production run
definition: The execution of a work order on equipment between a start and an end time.
examples: R-1042 on filler-01 of line 1, 08:00 to 10:00

name: Shift
label: Shift
definition: A scheduled working period of a site. KPIs are usually reported per shift.
examples: morning shift, 06:00 to 14:00

name: WorkOrder
label: Work order
definition: A request to produce a quantity of one product.
examples: WO-1042: 46,000 bottles of still water 500 ml

name: Characteristic
label: Characteristic
definition: A measurable property of the product that quality controls.
examples: cap removal torque, fill volume

name: DefectType
label: Defect type
definition: A named kind of defect, counted the same way everywhere.
examples: leak at cap, label skewed

name: Finding
label: Finding
definition: One defect type found in one inspection, with how many units showed it.
examples: 37 leaks at cap in inspection Q-1042

name: Inspection
label: Inspection
definition: A quality check carried out on a lot, ending in a decision.
examples: Q-1042: inspection of lot L-1042, result HOLD

name: Measurement
label: Measurement
definition: One measured value of a characteristic, taken during an inspection.
examples: 1.31 N·m on a sample of lot L-1043

name: NonConformance
label: Non-conformance
definition: A formal record that a lot does not meet requirements, with what was decided about it.
examples: NC-002: lot L-1043 rejected for leaks, to be scrapped

name: Specification
label: Specification
definition: The accepted range of one characteristic for one product.
examples: cap removal torque of still water 500 ml: 1.4 to 2.0 N·m

name: canTransitionTo
label: can transition to
definition: A state change that is physically and procedurally possible. A reported change that is not listed here signals a data or integration problem.

name: fromOperatingState
label: from operating state
definition: The harmonized state the equipment was in before the change.

name: hasCapability
label: has capability
definition: What this equipment is able to do in its current configuration.

name: hasDataPoint
label: has data point
definition: The values available for this asset.

name: hasPart
label: has part
definition: Inverse of partOf: the assets directly contained in this one.

name: hasRole
label: has role
definition: The function this person performs.

name: occurredOn
label: occurred on
definition: The asset the event happened to.

name: ofClass
label: of class
definition: The kind of equipment this machine is.

name: partOf
label: part of
definition: Containment in the equipment hierarchy. Transitive: a filler partOf line 1 partOf area partOf site.

name: performedBy
label: performed by
definition: Who carried out the event.

name: toOperatingState
label: to operating state
definition: The harmonized state the equipment entered.

name: baselineFor
label: baseline for
definition: The product an energy baseline applies to.

name: carrier
label: carrier
definition: The energy carrier a meter measures.

name: measuredBy
label: measured by
definition: The meter that recorded a consumption interval.

name: meters
label: meters
definition: The asset a meter measures. A meter on a line measures all of its equipment.

name: consumed
label: consumed
definition: Genealogy link: the material lots that went into a run.

name: locatedIn
label: located in
definition: The asset, usually a site or a line, where a storage location is.

name: materialOf
label: material of
definition: The catalogue material a lot is made of.

name: stockOf
label: stock of
definition: The material lot a stock item holds.

name: storedAt
label: stored at
definition: Where a stock item sits.

name: suppliedBy
label: supplied by
definition: The supplier that delivered a material lot.

name: affects
label: affects
definition: The component a failure mode damages or depends on.

name: causedBy
label: caused by
definition: The failure mode behind a stop.

name: covers
label: covers
definition: The component a maintenance plan keeps in condition.

name: fits
label: fits
definition: The component a spare part can replace.

name: replaced
label: replaced
definition: The component exchanged during the order.

name: resolves
label: resolves
definition: The stop a maintenance order was raised to fix.

name: usedSpare
label: used spare
definition: The spare part consumed by the order.

name: executes
label: executes
definition: The work order a run is fulfilling.

name: forProduct
label: for product
definition: The product a work order asks for.

name: lotOf
label: lot of
definition: The product a lot contains.

name: produced
label: produced
definition: The lot that came out of a run.

name: requiresCapability
label: requires capability
definition: What equipment must be able to do for this product to be made. A line can run the product when its equipment covers every required capability.

name: toProduct
label: to product
definition: The product a changeover prepares the line for.

name: concerns
label: concerns
definition: The lot a non-conformance is about.

name: defectType
label: defect type
definition: Which kind of defect a finding counts.

name: hasFinding
label: has finding
definition: The defects an inspection counted.

name: hasMeasurement
label: has measurement
definition: The values measured during an inspection.

name: inspects
label: inspects
definition: The lot an inspection examined.

name: ofCharacteristic
label: of characteristic
definition: The characteristic a measurement or a specification refers to.

name: raisedBy
label: raised by
definition: The inspection that opened the non-conformance.

name: specFor
label: specification for
definition: The product a specification applies to.

name: assetId
label: asset id
definition: Stable business identifier, the same in UNS, MES and CMMS.

name: endTime
label: end time
definition: When the event ended. Absent while the event is still open.

name: isProductive
label: is productive
definition: True when time in this state counts as running time for availability.

name: lastUpdate
label: last update
definition: When lastValue was received.

name: lastValue
label: last value
definition: Most recent value received from the UNS. Written by the bridge, never by hand.

name: startTime
label: start time
definition: When the event began.

name: toState
label: to state
definition: The state text exactly as received, kept even when it matches no known operating state.

name: unit
label: unit
definition: Engineering unit of the value.

name: unsTopic
label: UNS topic
definition: Where the live value of this data point is published in the Unified Namespace.

name: expectedKwhPer1000
label: expected kWh per 1,000
definition: Expected energy per thousand good units.

name: kWh
label: kWh
definition: Energy recorded in the interval, in kilowatt-hours.

name: tolerancePct
label: tolerance percent
definition: How far above the expected value is still accepted, in percent.

name: quantity
label: quantity
definition: Units on hand in the stock item.

name: receivedOn
label: received on
definition: When the material lot arrived.

name: dueDate
label: due date
definition: When the plan must be carried out next.

name: intervalDays
label: interval days
definition: Days between two executions of the plan.

name: lastExecuted
label: last executed
definition: When the plan was last carried out.

name: planned
label: planned
definition: True for stops that were scheduled, such as lunch. Planned stops do not count against availability.

name: stockQty
label: stock quantity
definition: Units of the spare part on hand.

name: goodQty
label: good quantity
definition: Units that left the run accepted.

name: idealCycleSeconds
label: ideal cycle seconds
definition: Ideal time to make one unit, the basis of OEE performance.

name: rejectQty
label: reject quantity
definition: Units rejected during the run.

name: targetQty
label: target quantity
definition: Units the work order asks for.

name: characteristicUnit
label: characteristic unit
definition: Unit in which the characteristic is measured.

name: defectCount
label: defect count
definition: Units showing the defect.

name: disposition
label: disposition
definition: What was decided for the lot: UNDER_INVESTIGATION, REWORK, SCRAP or RELEASE.

name: lowerLimit
label: lower limit
definition: Smallest accepted value.

name: result
label: result
definition: The decision of the inspection: PASS, HOLD or REJECT.

name: upperLimit
label: upper limit
definition: Largest accepted value.

name: value
label: value
definition: The measured value, in the unit of the characteristic.

name: Faulted
label: FAULTED
definition: Halted by a fault. It must be reset, which takes it to STOPPED, before it can run again.

name: Idle
label: IDLE
definition: Ready and waiting: no material, no order, or blocked downstream.

name: Running
label: RUNNING
definition: Producing at any speed.

name: Stopped
label: STOPPED
definition: Halted on purpose by an operator or by the schedule.
